parlare.note: Row parlare + noun / con dropped (parlare di kept unchanged): parlare a qualcuno is equally standard for 'talk to sb', so the calque 'a' is a correct answer; the profile says to leave out heads where two prepositions are equally accepted.

servire.note: servire a + infinitive and servire per + infinitive are both standard (serve per tagliare il pane); the calque 'per' would be marked wrong although correct.

trattare.note: trattare is also transitive with the same meaning (il libro tratta la storia antica), so the calque ∅ is acceptable Italian; two equally accepted patterns.

entrare.note: example 'Entriamo in casa con la pioggia' is unnatural; replaced by 'Entriamo in casa perché piove.'

pagare.note: example 'Pago il caffè per tutti' contains per in another role while per is the calque distractor; replaced by 'Stasera pago io la cena.'

smettere.note: 'Smetto di fumare da un anno' is ungrammatical (punctual verb with da + duration in the present); replaced by 'Ho smesso di fumare un anno fa.'

tornare.note: differs_from_english -> false, calque ∅ removed: English 'go back to doing' has 'to', which maps to a; no English habit gives ∅.

credere.note: Two rows fixed. credere a: example 'Non credo a quello che dice' allows the transitive too (non credo quello che dice), making the calque ∅ acceptable; replaced by a person object, 'Non credo più a mio cugino.' credere in: differs_from_english -> false, calque removed, since 'believe in' = credere in.

ricordarsi.note: With a noun, ricordarsi qualcosa (non mi ricordo il suo nome) is as standard as ricordarsi di, so the calque ∅ was correct Italian. Changed to the fixed pattern ricordarsi di + infinitive: en_pattern 'to remember to do sth', calque a, example 'Ricordati di chiudere la porta.'

diverso.note: differs_from_english -> false, calque removed: 'different from' = diverso da word for word.
